title: was / were
explain_tr: **be** fiilinin geçmiş hâli iki tanedir: **was** (I, he, she, it) ve **were** (you, we, they). Türkçedeki *"-dı / -ydı"*: *Dün evdeydim* → *I **was** at home yesterday.*
Olumsuz: **wasn't / weren't** → *She **wasn't** at work.* Soru: be başa gelir → ***Were** you tired?* – *Yes, I **was**. / No, I **wasn't**.*
Türkçede *"yorgundum, hastaydı, kalabalıktı"* tek kelimedir; İngilizcede **was/were mutlaka yazılır**: *I tired yesterday* ✗ → *I **was** tired yesterday* ✓.
Geçmişteki **there is / there are** → **there was / there were**: *There **were** a lot of people at the party.*
Zaman ifadeleri: *yesterday, last night/week/year, two days ago, in 2020, when I was a child*.
explain_en: Past of be: was (I/he/she/it), were (you/we/they). Negative: wasn't/weren't. Question: Was/Were + subject…? Never drop was/were before adjectives, nouns or places.

pairs.wrong: Did you be at home last night?
pairs.right: Were you at home last night?
pairs.note_tr: be ile soru: did kullanılmaz → **Were** you…?

pairs.wrong: There was many people at the concert.
pairs.right: There were many people at the concert.

exercises.prompt: I ___ very happy yesterday because I passed my exam.
My parents ___ in Kashgar last summer.
___ you at the meeting this morning?
The film ___ (not) very good, so we left early.
There ___ a lot of cars on the road yesterday.
We was very tired after the trip.
answer: We were very tired after the trip.
The weather was beautiful last weekend.

exercises.prompt: Did she be at school yesterday?
There was two cats in the garden.
answer: There were two cats in the garden.
